Subject:BoardMeeting
Dear Sir,
This is to inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be
held on Monday, 20 April 2026 at 2:00 p.m. at Karachi, to consider the Quarterly
Accounts for the period ended 31 March 2026 for declaration of any entitlement.
The Company has declared the “Closed Period" from 13 April 2026 to 20 April 2026 as
required under PSX Regulations. Accordingly, no Director, CEO or Executive shall,
directly / indirectly, deal in shares of the Company in any manner during the Closed
Period.
You may please inform the members of Exchange accordingly.
Yours sincerely,
-laisl
Faisal Abid
CompanySecretary
